metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a session_skill for deploying Mooncake Store as a hierarchical KV cache backend in multi-node LLM inference. It is semantically distinct from peer macro_protocols (which cover integration patterns and disaggregated architecture) and the micro_skill (checkpoint distribution). The candidate operates at session granularity with concrete workflow steps for KV cache tier management, offloading, and prefetching—a capability not present in existing_skills (which cover static asset serving and Maven builds, unrelated domains). The support evidence confirms Mooncake Store's role in disaggregated inference. No merge, split, or revision applies because there is no overlapping existing session_skill with the same asset_node_id and task_family.
